description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Kiora's Follower has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Kiora's Follower or Ioreth of the Healing House
